analyst_view.overall: A relegation fight: Le Havre (18th, 2 pts, five straight league defeats) host Strasbourg (16th, 10 pts, four losses in five) on Saturday evening. Both clubs have new coaches who lost their first game: Valerien Ismael at Le Havre (3-1 at Troyes) and Vitor Matos at Strasbourg (1-0 at home to Brest). Le Havre lose Enzo Koffi to suspension and have a long injury list (Mpasi, Zagadou, Mambimbi, Pembele, plus Jelert, Ndiaye, Nakamura and Mosengo per lineup sites); Strasbourg are without Panichelli, Reyna, Oso and Fabio Balde, with goalkeeper Jorgensen doubtful, and the numbers already take Reyna and Oso off. Most of these absences are long-standing and show in both sides' poor form, which the numbers see. Geoffrey Kubler referees (5.0 cards a game in a small sample, already counted); the one thing the numbers can't see is the pressure of a must-win game for two struggling sides, which I think adds a few cards.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, 1.4 for Le Havre and 1.5 for Strasbourg; both defences leak (Le Havre conceded 18 in six) and the numbers already take about 11% off Strasbourg for Reyna's absence. Both new coaches may tighten up first, but neither has shown it yet and the injury lists are not new, so I stay at 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.2 corners, with both sides winning slightly fewer than usual lately, which the momentum already reflects. Le Havre are expected in a 3-5-2 and Strasbourg in their usual 4-2-3-1, so nothing on tactics changes the picture and I stay at about 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, already lifted about 7% for referee Geoffrey Kubler and counting both sides' recent cards, but they have no stakes flag for this game. It is a bottom-of-the-table meeting with two new coaches desperate for a first win, so I lean a little higher, 4.1 to about 4.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots, already boosted because Le Havre have been shooting a lot lately (96 in six) even while losing. Strasbourg's missing forwards (Panichelli, Balde) have been out for weeks and are in their form, so I stay at 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target, about level between the sides. Both defences are weakened by long-term injuries that the recent numbers already show, and a doubtful Strasbourg goalkeeper does not change how many shots are on target, so I stay at about 9.
